cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: You Could at Least…
cards.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Dinner's ready. I'm keeping things pleasant, so I've put the sock I soaked in your spill beside your plate.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Please don't put a wet sock near my food.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I decide the table arrangement, and the empty chair is better. You'll still be able to see it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's where I sit. Can we just eat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll hold it under the table. A quick sorry and I can put it in the wash; then we'll both have our hands free.
